software.label: Software engineer
software.project: Build and deploy one complete app that solves a real problem (for example an expense tracker or a college notice board) with a database, login and tests, and keep the code on GitHub with a clear README.
interview: Data structures and algorithms (arrays, strings, trees, graphs)
Explaining one project end to end

backend.label: Backend developer
backend.project: Build a REST API for a real problem (for example a library or clinic booking system) with login, a database and tests, and deploy it on a free tier.
interview: Explaining one project end to end

frontend.label: Frontend developer
frontend.project: Build a responsive website in React that uses a public API (for example data.gov.in), works on phones, and is deployed with a live link.

fullstack.label: Full-stack developer
fullstack.project: Build a full-stack app with sign-in, a database and a React frontend, and deploy both parts.
interview: How the frontend talks to the backend

mobile.label: Mobile app developer
mobile.project: Publish a small useful app (for example an expense tracker with offline storage) and share the APK or store link.

data_analyst.label: Data analyst
data_analyst.project: Analyse a public dataset from data.gov.in, clean it with Excel or Python, and publish a dashboard that answers three clear questions.
interview: Explaining a chart to a non-technical person
A case study: what would you measure?

data_scientist.label: Data scientist / ML
data_scientist.project: Train and evaluate a model on a public dataset (for example predicting crop yield), explain its accuracy honestly, and share a notebook.

devops.label: DevOps / cloud
devops.project: Containerise an app, set up automatic tests and deployment with GitHub Actions, and run it on a cloud free tier.

qa.label: QA / test engineer
qa.project: Write an automated test suite (UI and API tests) for an open-source app and run it in CI.

design.label: UI/UX or graphic designer
design.project: Redesign one screen of a public-service website, show research, before and after, and a clickable Figma prototype in a portfolio.

accounts.label: Accounts and finance
accounts.project: Keep a full month of books for a sample business in Tally, file a mock GST return, and prepare a simple profit and loss statement.

sales.label: Sales and business development
sales.project: Write a short sales pitch for a local product, role-play it, and track ten sample leads in a free CRM.
interview: Pitching a product in two minutes

marketing.label: Marketing
marketing.project: Run a small social media page for a month, plan the posts, and report reach and engagement with screenshots.

content.label: Content writer
content.project: Publish five well-researched articles on a free blog and collect them as writing samples.

hr.label: Human resources
hr.project: Design a full hiring process for a sample role: job post, screening questions, interview sheet and offer letter.

support.label: Customer support
support.project: Write answers for twenty common customer questions for a sample product and practise them in a mock call.

operations.label: Operations and logistics
operations.project: Build an Excel stock tracker with reorder alerts for a sample shop and write a one-page process guide.

teaching.label: Teaching
teaching.project: Plan and record a 15-minute lesson on one topic, with a worksheet and a short quiz.

healthcare.label: Healthcare
healthcare.project: Complete a recognised certificate (for example first aid) and keep a log of supervised clinical practice.

office.label: Office and data entry
office.project: Build a clean, formatted Excel record book for a sample office with sorting, filters and a summary sheet.

engineering.label: Core engineering
engineering.project: Model and document a small real design (for example a bracket or a floor plan) in AutoCAD or SolidWorks with drawings.
